tableInfo.name: 指示履歴
tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH LOG_CHANGE_LOG_ALL AS ( {1} ),RST_DIALYSIS_HST_EDITION AS ( SELECT EDITION ,UP_DATE,DIALYSIS_NO, NVL(LAG(UP_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY DEVICE_NO ORDER BY UP_DATE DESC),SYSDATE) AS UP_DATE_END FROM RST_DIALYSIS_HST WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ), RST_DIALYSIS_HST_NEW AS ( SELECT a.EDITION ,a.DIALYSIS_NO,a.SEND_DATE, case when b.SEND_DATE is null then SYSDATE else b.SEND_DATE end END_DATE FROM ( SELECT EDITION, SEND_DATE ,DIALYSIS_NO, row_number ( ) over ( PARTITION BY DIALYSIS_NO ORDER BY EDITION ) rn FROM RST_DIALYSIS_HST WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') a left join ( SELECT EDITION, SEND_DATE ,DIALYSIS_NO, row_number ( ) over ( PARTITION BY DIALYSIS_NO ORDER BY EDITION ) rn FROM RST_DIALYSIS_HST WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') b on a.DIALYSIS_NO=b.DIALYSIS_NO and a.RN=b.RN-1 ORDER BY DIALYSIS_NO, EDITION ),MST_LLT_KIND_INFO AS ( SELECT KIND_ID, KIND_NAME, UP_DATE, nvl( lead ( UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) over ( PARTITION BY KIND_ID ORDER BY KIND_ID, UP_DATE ASC ), SYSDATE ) AS enddate FROM MST_LLT_KIND ), STAFF_INFO AS ( SELECT trim(STAFF_CD) AS STAFF_CD, STAFF_NAME, UP_DATE, nvl( lead ( UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) over ( PARTITION BY STAFF_CD ORDER BY STAFF_CD, UP_DATE ASC ), SYSDATE ) AS enddate FROM MST_STAFF ),PAT_BBS_INF_INFO AS ( SELECT SEQ_ID, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PUBLISH_START, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') as PUBLISH_START, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PUBLISH_END, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') as PUBLISH_END, ALL_STAFF_FLG, UP_DATE, nvl( lead ( UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) over ( PARTITION BY SEQ_ID ORDER BY SEQ_ID, UP_DATE ASC ), SYSDATE ) AS enddate FROM PAT_BBS_INF ), LIFE_LIST_INFO AS ( SELECT A.KIND_ID, A.STAFF_CD, A.OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, KIND_NAME, A.REG_DATE, A.PATID, PUBLISH_START AS PUBLISH_START_END, LAG ( PUBLISH_START ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS PUBLISH_START, PUBLISH_END AS PUBLISH_END_END, LAG ( PUBLISH_END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS PUBLISH_END, ALL_STAFF_FLG AS ALL_STAFF_FLG_END, LAG ( ALL_STAFF_FLG ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS ALL_STAFF_FLG, TO_CHAR( TO_DATE( A.REG_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD' ), 'YYYY/MM/DD' ) AS REG_DATE_END, TO_CHAR( to_date( a.reg_date || a.reg_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI' ), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI' ) AS LAG_INFO_END_HHMM, LAG ( TO_CHAR( TO_DATE( A.REG_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD' ), 'YYYY/MM/DD' ) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS LAG_INFO_YYYY, LAG ( TO_CHAR( to_date( a.reg_date || a.reg_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI' ), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI' ) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS LAG_INFO_HHMM , DETAIL1 AS LAG_INFO_END, DETAIL2 AS LAG_INFO_END1, DETAIL3 AS LAG_INFO_END2, DETAIL4 AS LAG_INFO_END3, BBS_SEQ_ID AS LAG_INFO_END4, A.DEL_FLG, LAG ( A.DEL_FLG ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS DEL_FLG1, nvl( r.DIALYSIS_NO, rs.DIALYSIS_NO ) AS DIALYSIS_NO, nvl( r.SERIES_CD, rs.SERIES_CD ) AS SERIES_CD, LAG ( DETAIL1 ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS LAG_INFO, LAG ( DETAIL2 ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS LAG_INFO1, LAG ( DETAIL3 ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS LAG_INFO2, LAG ( DETAIL4 ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS LAG_INFO3, LAG ( BBS_SEQ_ID ) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.SEQ_ID ORDER BY A.OCCUR_DATE ASC ) AS LAG_INFO4 FROM (SELECT SEQ_ID, KIND_ID, STAFF_CD , OCCUR_DATE , PATID, REG_DATE, REG_TIME, DETAIL1, DETAIL2, DETAIL3, DETAIL4, BBS_SEQ_ID,DEL_FLG FROM ( SELECT SEQ_ID, KIND_ID, trim( EDIT_CD ) AS STAFF_CD, UP_DATE AS OCCUR_DATE, PATID, REG_DATE, REG_TIME, DETAIL1, DETAIL2, DETAIL3, DETAIL4, BBS_SEQ_ID, ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY SEQ_ID ORDER BY UP_DATE DESC ) rn,DEL_FLG FROM PAT_LIFE_LIST WHERE UP_DATE <= ( SELECT max( CONVERT_DATETIME ) FROM sync_convert_history ch WHERE facility_cd =:facility_cd AND table_kind = 'PAT' ) ) a WHERE a.rn = 1 and SEQ_ID in( select SEQ_ID from PAT_LIFE_LIST where UP_DATE > ( SELECT max( CONVERT_DATETIME ) FROM sync_convert_history ch WHERE facility_cd =:facility_cd AND table_kind = 'PAT' ) ) union all SELECT SEQ_ID, KIND_ID, trim( EDIT_CD ) AS STAFF_CD, UP_DATE AS OCCUR_DATE, PATID, REG_DATE, REG_TIME, DETAIL1, DETAIL2, DETAIL3, DETAIL4, BBS_SEQ_ID,DEL_FLG FROM PAT_LIFE_LIST WHERE UP_DATE > ( SELECT max( CONVERT_DATETIME ) FROM sync_convert_history ch WHERE facility_cd =:facility_cd AND table_kind = 'PAT' ) ) A LEFT JOIN STAFF_INFO S ON A.STAFF_CD = S.STAFF_CD AND a.OCCUR_DATE > S.UP_DATE AND a.OCCUR_DATE < S.enddate LEFT JOIN MST_LLT_KIND_INFO K ON A.KIND_ID = K.KIND_ID AND A.OCCUR_DATE > K.UP_DATE AND A.OCCUR_DATE < K.enddate LEFT JOIN PAT_BBS_INF_INFO b ON A.BBS_SEQ_ID = b.SEQ_ID AND A.OCCUR_DATE >= b.UP_DATE AND A.OCCUR_DATE < b.enddate LEFT JOIN RST_DIALYSIS r ON A.PATID = r.PATID AND to_date( a.reg_date || a.reg_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) >= r.ENTER_DATE AND to_date( a.reg_date || a.reg_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) <= r.LEAVE_DATE AND r.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' LEFT JOIN RST_DIALYSIS rs ON A.PATID = rs.PATID AND to_date( a.reg_date || a.reg_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) >= rs.START_DATE AND to_date( a.reg_date || a.reg_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) <= rs.END_DATE AND r.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) select '0'as NO,STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE,STAFF_NAME, LOG_CHANGE,DIALYSIS_NO,EDITION from( SELECT rsc.*,c.EDITION FROM LOG_CHANGE_LOG_ALL rsc INNER JOIN RST_DIALYSIS r ON rsc.DIALYSIS_NO = r.DIALYSIS_NO AND r.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' LEFT outer JOIN RST_DIALYSIS_HST_NEW c ON ( rsc.DIALYSIS_NO = c.DIALYSIS_NO AND rsc.OCCUR_DATE <= c.END_DATE AND rsc.OCCUR_DATE > c.SEND_DATE ) {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} order by OCCUR_DATE ) a union all select NO,rsc.STAFF_CD, rsc.OCCUR_DATE, rsc.STAFF_NAME, rsc.LOG_CHANGE,rsc.DIALYSIS_NO,e.EDITION from( SELECT '0' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || 'を新規登録' AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE DEL_FLG1 IS NULL AND DEL_FLG='0' and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' UNION ALL SELECT '10' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || ' の 開始日時 '||LAG_INFO_YYYY|| 'を削除' AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE DEL_FLG1='0' AND DEL_FLG='1' and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' UNION ALL SELECT '1' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || ' の 開始日時 を ' || nvl( LAG_INFO_YYYY, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || REG_DATE_END AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and ( LAG_INFO_YYYY IS NOT NULL AND REG_DATE_END IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_YYYY != REG_DATE_END ) OR ( LAG_INFO_YYYY IS NOT NULL AND REG_DATE_END IS NULL ) OR ( LAG_INFO_YYYY IS NULL AND REG_DATE_END IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '2' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || ' の 開始日時 を ' || nvl( LAG_INFO_HHMM, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || LAG_INFO_END_HHMM AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and ( LAG_INFO_HHMM IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END_HHMM IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_HHMM != LAG_INFO_END_HHMM ) OR ( LAG_INFO_HHMM IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END_HHMM IS NULL ) OR ( LAG_INFO_HHMM IS NULL AND LAG_INFO_END_HHMM IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '3' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, CASE KIND_ID WHEN 0 THEN '観察記録：観察記録 SOAP の S を ' || nvl( LAG_INFO, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || nvl( LAG_INFO_END, '未登録' ) ELSE '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || ' の TEXT を ' || nvl( LAG_INFO, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || nvl( LAG_INFO_END, '未登録' ) END AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and ( LAG_INFO IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO != LAG_INFO_END ) OR ( LAG_INFO IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END IS NULL ) OR ( LAG_INFO IS NULL AND LAG_INFO_END IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '4' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 SOAP の O を ' || nvl( LAG_INFO1, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || nvl( LAG_INFO_END1, '未登録' ) AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and KIND_ID = 0 AND ( LAG_INFO1 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END1 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO1 != LAG_INFO_END1 ) OR ( LAG_INFO1 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END1 IS NULL ) OR ( LAG_INFO1 IS NULL AND LAG_INFO_END1 IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '5' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 SOAP の A を ' || nvl( LAG_INFO2, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || nvl( LAG_INFO_END2, '未登録' ) AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and KIND_ID = 0 AND ( LAG_INFO2 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END2 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO2 != LAG_INFO_END2 ) OR ( LAG_INFO2 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END2 IS NULL ) OR ( LAG_INFO2 IS NULL AND LAG_INFO_END2 IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '6' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 SOAP の P を ' || nvl( LAG_INFO3, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || nvl( LAG_INFO_END3, '未登録' ) AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and KIND_ID = 0 AND ( LAG_INFO3 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END3 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO3 != LAG_INFO_END3 ) OR ( LAG_INFO3 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END3 IS NULL ) OR ( LAG_INFO3 IS NULL AND LAG_INFO_END3 IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '7' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || ' の 掲示板リンク 掲載有無 を ' || NVL2( LAG_INFO4, '掲載する', '掲載なし' ) || ' ⇒' || NVL2( LAG_INFO_END4, '掲載する', '掲載なし' ) AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and ( LAG_INFO4 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END4 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO4 != LAG_INFO_END4 ) OR ( LAG_INFO4 IS NOT NULL AND LAG_INFO_END4 IS NULL ) OR ( LAG_INFO4 IS NULL AND LAG_INFO_END4 IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '8' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || ' の 掲示板リンク 掲載期間 を ' || NVL2( PUBLISH_START, PUBLISH_START || '～' || PUBLISH_END, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || NVL2( PUBLISH_START_END, PUBLISH_START_END || '～' || PUBLISH_END_END, '未登録' ) AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and ( PUBLISH_START IS NOT NULL AND PUBLISH_START_END IS NOT NULL AND PUBLISH_START || '～' || PUBLISH_END != PUBLISH_START_END || '～' || PUBLISH_END_END ) OR ( PUBLISH_START IS NOT NULL AND PUBLISH_START_END IS NULL ) OR ( PUBLISH_START IS NULL AND PUBLISH_START_END IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT '9' AS NO, STAFF_CD, OCCUR_DATE, STAFF_NAME, '観察記録：観察記録 ' || KIND_NAME || ' の 掲示板リンク スタッフ を ' || NVL2( ALL_STAFF_FLG, CASE WHEN ALL_STAFF_FLG = '1' THEN '全スタッフ' ELSE '個別スタッフ' END, '未登録' ) || ' ⇒' || NVL2( ALL_STAFF_FLG_END, CASE WHEN ALL_STAFF_FLG_END = '1' THEN '全スタッフ' ELSE '個別スタッフ' END, '未登録' ) AS LOG_CHANGE, DIALYSIS_NO FROM LIFE_LIST_INFO WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and ( ALL_STAFF_FLG IS NOT NULL AND ALL_STAFF_FLG_END IS NOT NULL AND ALL_STAFF_FLG != ALL_STAFF_FLG_END ) OR ( ALL_STAFF_FLG IS NOT NULL AND ALL_STAFF_FLG_END IS NULL ) OR ( ALL_STAFF_FLG IS NULL AND ALL_STAFF_FLG_END IS NOT NULL ) ) rsc LEFT outer JOIN RST_DIALYSIS_HST_EDITION e ON ( rsc.DIALYSIS_NO = e.DIALYSIS_NO AND rsc.OCCUR_DATE < e.UP_DATE_END AND rsc.OCCUR_DATE >= e.UP_DATE ) where rsc.DIALYSIS_NO is not null and rsc.OCCUR_DATE >(select max(CONVERT_DATETIME) from sync_convert_history ch where facility_cd=:facility_cd AND table_kind = 'PAT') ORDER BY OCCUR_DATE,NO
